// @path: src/lib/somewhere.ts
// Two things that are not queries over user input and must not be made to look
// like a problem, or the gate gets switched off.
//
// A literal cannot be user-supplied. A type declaration is a shape rather than a
// value — `establishmentWhere`'s return type spells all three operators out, and
// there is nothing there to sanitise.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export type Where = {
  OR: ({ name: { startsWith: string } } | { name: { contains: string } })[];
};

export async function findDrafts() {
  return db.activityTemplate.findMany({ where: { title: { contains: "Untitled" } } });
}
